# Qubits: q0, q1 are inputs; q2 is workspace; q3 is ancilla
# Compute condition: (q0 AND q1) OR (NOT q0 AND NOT q1) style example
# Here we implement: ancilla = (q0 AND q1) OR (q2 from NOT q0 AND NOT q1)

# Compute NOT q0 AND NOT q1 into workspace q2
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.x(qr[1])
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[1], qr[2])
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.x(qr[1])

# Compute q0 AND q1 into ancilla q3
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[1], qr[3])

# Combine workspace into ancilla (OR-like accumulation via CX)
qc.cx(qr[2], qr[3])

# Apply Z phase on ancilla
qc.z(qr[3])

# Uncompute
qc.cx(qr[2], qr[3])
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[1], qr[3])
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.x(qr[1])
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[1], qr[2])

# 3-qubit QFT
def qft(circuit, qubits):
    n = len(qubits)
    for j in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        circuit.h(qubits[j])
        for k in range(j - 1, -1, -1):
            circuit.cp(np.pi / (2 ** (j - k)), qubits[k], qubits[j])
    for i in range(n // 2):
        circuit.swap(qubits[i], qubits[n - 1 - i])

def iqft(circuit, qubits):
    n = len(qubits)
    for i in range(n // 2):
        circuit.swap(qubits[i], qubits[n - 1 - i])
    for j in range(n):
        for k in range(j):
            circuit.cp(-np.pi / (2 ** (j - k)), qubits[k], qubits[j])
        circuit.h(qubits[j])

qr = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
cr = ClassicalRegister(3, 'c')
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

# Bell pair on qubits 1 and 2
qc.h(qr[1])
qc.cx(qr[1], qr[2])

# Put qubit 0 into a Hadamard state
qc.h(qr[0])

# Bell-basis steps on qubits 0 and 1
qc.cx(qr[0], qr[1])
qc.h(qr[0])

# Measure qubits 0 and 1
qc.measure(qr[0], cr[0])
qc.measure(qr[1], cr[1])

# Corrections
qc.cx(qr[1], qr[2])
qc.cz(qr[0], qr[2])

# Measure qubit 2
qc.measure(qr[2], cr[2])
